title: Off-Canvas Mobile Navigation Drawer

desc: Refactored consultation form to submit asynchronously via AJAX with button loading states, removed duplicate top flash banners, and integrated seamless inline transmission feedback directly under the button.

desc: Replaced homepage work section with modular client testimonials component featuring a 5-star trust badge card, a 4-metric enterprise KPI ribbon, verified client case quotes, and bottom conversion CTAs.

title: Mobile Horizontal Touch Carousels
desc: Converted tall vertical card stacks for Testimonials, Portfolio discovery cards, and Services solutions into swipeable horizontal touch tracks with CSS scroll-snap, hidden scrollbars, and swipe hints.

title: Mobile Excessive Vertical Space Elimination
desc: Eliminated 200px+ wasted white spaces between consecutive sections on mobile screens by overriding global section padding to 36px, removing hardcoded inline margins, and tightening header spacing.

title: Official Favicon & Multi-Platform Icons
desc: Generated pixel-crisp favicons (32x32, 180x180 Apple touch icon, 192x192, and root favicon.ico) from the official JZARR Tech logo and updated header tags for seamless browser and bookmark recognition.

title: Standalone Static HTML Exports
desc: Generated pre-rendered standalone .html files for all 7 primary pages with auto-mapped internal navigation links, enabling offline previews and zero-config deployment on static hosting platforms.

title: Page Title & Meta Tag Deduplication

title: Enterprise .htaccess & Security Configuration
desc: Configured production Apache rules for single-hop HTTPS/apex canonicalization, clean extensionless URLs, strict .env and .md blocking, high-performance Gzip/Brotli compression, and immutable asset caching.

title: Custom Branded 404 Error Page Infrastructure
desc: Designed and routed a custom cyber-luxury 404.html error page via ErrorDocument directive, guiding visitors back to the homepage and service solutions instead of showing generic server error screens.

title: Architecture Documentation & HISTORY.md Log
desc: Authored a full README.md overview and an in-depth HISTORY.md architectural log detailing the complete chronological development roadmap, component hierarchy, and guidelines for future engineers.
